title: Render review (pre- or post-render)
description: Used by both stages 5 (pre-render) and 7 (post-render). The stage field disambiguates. Pre-render gates whether the renderer runs at all; post-render gates whether the output ships and what the story contributes to the learning index.

consumed_by: operator — pre-render decision='render' triggers the renderer; 'iterate' returns to stages 3-4
operator — post-render decision='publish' ships; 'iterate' returns to stage 3; 'scrap' ends the story
stage 8 — failure-class entries trace back to blockers[] / warns[] here; subjective_quality copied into 08_learning

stage.description: 'pre-render' (stage 5) or 'post-render' (stage 7). Drives which fields are required by the conditional rules below.

blockers.description: Findings that must be resolved before the next gate. Pre-render: any blocker forces decision='iterate'. Post-render: any blocker forces decision='iterate' regardless of subjective_quality.

warns.description: Issues a human should know about but that do not stop the flow. Stage 7 may flag a stage-5 warn that turned out to be a real problem in the render.

infos.description: Pass-through observations. Used to record that a check ran and was clean, or to note context (e.g. 'no approved example for this type yet').

decision.description: Pre-render: 'render' iff blockers=[]; else 'iterate'. Post-render: 'publish' iff subjective_quality>=4 and blockers=[]; 'iterate' iff blockers!=[] or quality=3; 'scrap' iff quality<=2.

approved_example_diff.description: Pre-render only. 1–2 sentences naming axes on which the current plan is weaker than the nearest approved example. null if no example exists for this story_type.

subjective_quality.description: Post-render only. 1–5 score with one-line justification. 5 beats current best on a named axis; 4 meets bar; 3 publishable with edits; 2 needs another iteration; 1 scrap.

subjective_quality_reason.description: Post-render only. One concrete line. 'Felt good' is not acceptable; name the module index and the axis.

module_findings.description: Post-render only. One row per module in 04_module-plan.json, recording whether the rendered output matched the plan.

matches_plan.description: True iff rendered text equals plan text.

duration_drift_sec.description: manifest_duration - plan_duration (signed). |drift|>1.0 is a pacing finding.

asset_honored.description: True iff manifest.asset_status='ok' and asset matches plan.asset_hint. False for fallbacks/placeholders.

notes.description: One-line observation if anything stood out (cut on a word boundary, text overflow visible, etc.).

pacing_findings.description: Post-render only. Free-text observations about hook landing, mid-word cuts, key-noun timing.

regressions_vs_approved_example.description: Post-render only. 1–3 specific named regressions vs the nearest approved example. null if no example exists.

allOf.description: Pre-render must include the approved-example diff field (null is acceptable when no example exists).
Post-render must include the subjective fields and module/pacing/regression findings.

check.description: Check id, ideally a class from playbook §2 (e.g. 'sourcing/single', 'hook/hedge', 'render/overflow').

detail.description: Specific evidence: file:line or field path plus what was wrong.

severity.description: Mirrors the array the finding lives in. Optional but recommended.
